phases.name: Base Throwing
phases.intent_summary: Rebuild flat-ground throwing base with conservative volume. Focus on arm path confidence and forearm tolerance.

phases.name: Mound Introduction
phases.intent_summary: First exposure to mound work at low volume. Monitor forearm response closely.

phases.name: Deload Week
phases.intent_summary: Reduced volume across all domains to allow supercompensation. Forearm work kept consistent.

phases.name: Mound Volume
phases.intent_summary: Systematic increase in mound throw count and flat-ground intensity. Maintain forearm conditioning.

phases.name: Pre-Competition
phases.intent_summary: Simulate in-season throwing/lifting schedule. Build toward full game readiness without actual game stress.

days.day_focus: Base flat-ground throwing with moderate lower-body lift.
cues: Keep throws easy—air it out gradually.

days.day_focus: Active recovery day. No throwing, light mobility.
Flat ground with extension throws, followed by upper pull and core.
cues: Extension throws: high arc, increasing distance.

days.day_focus: Long toss introduction with lower power work.
cues: Long toss: reach 120ft by end of phase.
Landings on bounds: stick and hold.

days.day_focus: Active recovery: light mobility and forearm maintenance.

cues: Chin-ups: full hang to chin over bar.

throwing_5tuple.note: Reach max distance and work back in.

days.day_focus: Long toss to max distance, lower power.
cues: Rotational throws: drive off back hip.

throwing_5tuple.note: First mound work. Move plate in to 50ft. Fastball only.

days.day_focus: First mound session — low volume, fastball command.
Flat ground volume, upper pull and core.
cues: Easy throws; focus on arm path.

throwing_5tuple.note: Second mound session. Fastball only, increase intent slightly.

days.day_focus: Deload mound session with reduced lifting volume.

throwing_5tuple.note: Low intensity, focus on arm path.

days.day_focus: Deload flat ground with upper pull.

throwing_5tuple.note: Second deload mound session. Fastball only.
Full bullpen: 40 throws, mix in breaking ball.

days.day_focus: Full bullpen (40 throws) with breaking ball. Pre-competition intensity.

throwing_5tuple.note: Bullpen: 45 throws, mix pitches, simulate innings.

days.day_focus: Peak bullpen volume (45 throws) before competition.

rationale.phase_logic: The program follows the 9-week Mound Reintroduction arc from the Return-to-Play Progression Model. Week 1-2 build flat-ground volume and distance (Base Throwing). Week 3 introduces mound work at 15 throws (Mound Introduction). Week 4 is a deload with reduced volume across the board. Weeks 5-7 scale mound volume from 20 to 30 throws (Mound Volume). Weeks 8-9 simulate pre-competition bullpen volumes (40-45 throws) with pitch mix. The progression respects the ACWR governor and the golden weekly throw counts (178-254).
rationale.individualization_notes: Landon has a history of forearm/UCL tightness, so elevated FPM volume is programmed on at least 4 days per week. Lifting intensity stays in the strength range (no strength-power) per RTP Stage 2 guidelines. Mound volume ladder starts at 15 throws and progresses conservatively. Warm-up ladder is standard per knowledge pack but omitted from 5tuple counts. Pull-to-push ratio exceeds 2:1 each week, with pull exercises like chest-supported row, face pull, weighted chin-up. Front squat is primary lower body compound (per previous modification).
